overview.name: Graniteshares YieldBOOST 20Y+ Treasuries ETF
overview.description: It is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks to pay weekly distributions by selling put options on the Underlying Leveraged ETF, which provides exposure to 3 times the daily performance of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
